findings.title: R1 misstates the GLU_CONTROL Arg-Lys contact distance and proposes harmful charge and constraint edits, though microstate and stereochemical uncertainty remain valid
findings.source_check: Retain the bounded source corrections and chemical microstate uncertainty. Do not describe a microelectron rounding adjustment as a demonstrated substantial physical error.

findings.title: DITY_LINKED closes an 8.630 A initial gap under backbone restraints, but reviewer claims of active 51.1 penalties, required n=1/n=3 terms, and hard angle gates are unsupported
findings.source_check: The preparation route and source-rule distinctions are verified. No final physical defect is inferred solely from a large starting gap or diagnostic angle.

findings.title: R3/R4's blanket PBC-wrapping and PRNG-reset claims are unfounded, whereas dry force-inventory reporting, wet-minimization sign skipping, and CPU precision labels are real audit defects
findings.source_check: Checkpoint-preservation and coordinate-convention corrections survive. Dry force inventory needs an explicit scope label, not an assertion that the wet System lacks solvent forces. Stage-to-stage checks are recommended; no inversion was demonstrated.

findings.title: Confounded precision and velocity seeds in GLU_CONTROL, zero post-restraint burn-in, and single-build pseudo-replication preclude causal variance claims
findings.source_check: Sampling/precision limitations survive, but a 30-frame autocorrelation estimate or one same-seed rerun is not decisive evidence of equilibrium or precision causation.

findings.title: Network regime extensions must account for oxidative bond restoration, zero-modulus tether limits, and exact finite-size line-cut normalization
findings.source_check: Network source corrections survive; this role did not execute a mechanical or phase sweep.

findings.title: Periodic line-cycle algebra (`2W` vs `3W` lines) shifts expected coordination `z`, whereas R5's claim that mean fiber length scales linearly with `W` is false
findings.source_check: Cycle enumeration and expected-coordination algebra are independently checked. Existing realized-z columns should remain intact.

findings.title: Adjudication of background springs (`k_gag` zero-bond counterexample vs `mu_el`), batch-summed L-BFGS coupling, and invalid generic rigidity shortcuts
findings.source_check: Background and solver tests survive; no generic graph shortcut, fixed threshold or numerical bias is established for the full model.

findings.title: Oxidative `dose` confounds five structural/constitutive changes, double-embrittles bridge bonds (`brittle^2`), and clamps anisotropic bridges at high `z`
findings.source_check: Compounded brittleness and coupled interventions are implementation choices to document and ablate. Proposed alternative physics is not automatically a repair.

findings.title: Identifiability limits of connectivity, clustering, and hub bias on a bounded (`k <= 6`) triangular lattice and blindness of Euler `mesh_size`
findings.source_check: Topology identifiability and metric limitations survive. Feasible rewiring ranges and mixing need verification before claiming isolated clustering effects.

findings.title: Sequential RNG stream coupling in `build_spec`, pre-cell replicate averaging (`groupby.mean`), and unvalidated reviewer threshold shortcuts
findings.source_check: Paired seed reuse is valid when blocked; split random streams help controlled ablations. Suggested effect sizes, precision targets and exploration fractions are proposed policy choices, not validated constants. Nonlinear averaging can lose uncertainty; its numerical bias is not quantified here.
